name: Parallel and Scalable LPM
aliases: GPU LPM with propagation and collecting steps
definition: A parallel GPU implementation of LPM that avoids synchronization problems by dividing the propagation step into two steps: a propagation step and a collecting step. This guarantees that each voxel is traversed by only one ray at a time within a specific direction block.
summary: Parallel and Scalable LPM is a GPU-optimized Light Propagation Maps implementation that eliminates race conditions by decoupling ray tracing into separate propagation and collecting steps.
